## Problem or workflow

What are you trying to do? Include the relevant database and platform, but no
credentials, private connection details, or real query data.

## Proposed improvement

Describe the behavior you would like and why it helps.

## Alternatives

What workarounds or other approaches have you considered?

## Compatibility and security

Would this affect existing profiles, permissions, credential storage, or command
execution? Mention any concerns you can identify.
